title: Bolden: contradictory information and the cylinder
summary: Russell resumes on Buddy Bolden, the lack of reliable facts and the disputed Bolden cylinder.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: We were talking about Bolden and the fact that there's so little real information and so much contradictory information, and he is such a key figure to the whole New Orleans scene. He's such a famous, legendary character that, of course, as I say, I don't think it's necessary to have to defend our viewpoint that he really was a real man and lived. But I do want to give a few items that I've collected over the years, things that I think about him and that I, as near as possible, have been able to find out about him. This is a question of the Bolden cylinder, which to a lot of people is a joke. A fellow from England stayed at my place last night and let him sleep on the floor in his bag.
